audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Darius/Darius/Skill/Darius/Skill/Darius/Darius; the mirror audit has already settled it as Darius through level 6 and Vladimir from first item on. The prose also disagreed with itself — whys[0..2] called levels 1-3 even while win[0] and win[1] said Darius. Difficulty said EVEN but carried a 7.5/10 rating, the red HARD tone and 'Tricky matchup'.
audit.why: Mirror-fix will overwrite any disagreement, and the four difficulty fields contradicted each other on the same page.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 and 4 to Darius, rows 5 and 6 to Vladimir, in matched pairs with ratings; whys[0..2] rewritten to say Darius; diffRating to 5/10, tone to the neutral swatch, and both difficulty strings restated as even.

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend's cooldown is the pivot of eleven instructions and was never given.
audit.why: 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 is the longest cooldown in the lane at rank 1 — a whiffed pull is a 26-second window where an immobile Darius cannot reach you. Crippling Strike at 5s and Noxian Guillotine at 120s complete the picture.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[2], phases[4], phases[5], early, breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.difficulty.

audit.whatIsWrong: Noxian Guillotine's true damage was never tied to itemization, and Crippling Strike's auto reset was never flagged as the burst tell.
audit.why: Building magic resist against Darius is the wrong answer for his kill button — the R ignores resistances entirely and scales on Hemorrhage stacks, so the counterplay is staying unbled or outside its 460 range. Crippling Strike is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the cue to step back, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: True damage written into phases[4] and report[5]; the reset written into breakdown.cooldowns and whys[1].

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Pool after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown here and your whole trade window. - Crippling Strike: 5s auto reset; the wind-up is the tell. - Noxian Guillotine: 120s true damage, refreshed on a kill. - Sanguine Pool: 28s.

edits.before: Track Darius's Apprehend (Pull): His all-in start. Pool after it. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is true damage — magic resist does not help here, only staying unbled does.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Apprehend and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Apprehend's 26s and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — both are melee-range trading and his combo isn't online yet.
edits.after: Darius wins level 1 — Decimate's blade out-damages and out-heals your Transfusion.

edits.before: Level 2 stays skill-based as you dodge his Q sweet spot and poke back.
edits.after: Level 2 is his: Crippling Strike is a 5s auto reset that slows you out of range.

edits.before: Level 3 remains even; respecting the E pull keeps trades neutral.
edits.after: Level 3 is his once Apprehend can pull you into a full bleed stack.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are skill-based: Darius is dangerous but immobile, so if you respect the outer-edge Decimate (Q) and don't stand where his Apprehend (E) can pull you into a bleed-stack all-in, you trade fine with Transfusion (Q) poke. Don't greed CS in E range. Keep your pool ready but unused so it's up for his commit.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 belong to Darius: he is immobile, but the outer-edge Decimate (Q) heals him off you and Apprehend (E) pulls you in from 535 range into a bleed-stack all-in. It is 26s at rank 1, so a whiffed pull is your only safe window. Don't greed CS in E range, and keep your pool unused for his commit.
